messages:
me_fin: Heads up  we have two invoices from Silverleaf Analytics: INV-8821 (received 2026-04-02) and INV-8821-1 (received 2026-04-05). AP auto-matched both to PO-2147 and routed for approval; system flagged potential duplicate payment. Can AP confirm whether one is a reissue or a true duplicate?
tara_procure: Pulling PO-2147. PO intentionally allows monthly milestone billing. Only one milestone due for March (amount 7,500 USD). Looks like vendor reissued with updated remittance instructions. Need vendor confirmation which one supersedes.
josh_ap: AP view: INV-8821 shows remittance to bank A (acct ****1234) and INV-8821-1 to bank B (acct ****9876). Amounts identical. Automatic duplicate detection flagged and put second invoice on hold.
vendor-bot: Silverleaf Analytics (billing@silverleaf.ai) uploaded INV-8821 (PDF) link: https://files.example.com/silverleaf/INV-8821.pdf
vendor-bot: Silverleaf Analytics uploaded INV-8821-1 (PDF) link: https://files.example.com/silverleaf/INV-8821-1.pdf
me_fin: Risk: different bank details could be fraud (invoice redirect). Treasury should verify new bank account before updating vendor payment info. Payments team, pls confirm which bank is on file and whether vendor requested change.
payments_lead: Current vendor master payment method: bank A (acct ****1234). We received no authenticated change request. Per policy, bank changes require signed bank detail change form + vendor representative verification. Until verified, we won't pay to bank B. Invoice INV-8821-1 remains payment_hold:true.
tara_procure: I'll ask vendor to confirm: reply needed with subject "Confirm remittance for INV-8821" and attach bank-change form if applicable.
vendor-bot: Message sent to billing@silverleaf.ai: "Please confirm if INV-8821-1 supersedes INV-8821 and provide signed bank-change authorization. Reply here to speed processing."
vendor-bot: Vendor replied: "INV-8821-1 was issued because our billing platform updated remittance details. We will provide signed bank change form within 24h. Please confirm you will pay INV-8821-1 upon receipt of docs."
josh_ap: Once we receive signed form and match to vendor master contact, we can update payment method and release hold. Meanwhile, can we temporarily mark INV-8821 as primary for payment to avoid delay? PO allows one invoice per milestone; we should not pay both.
finance-bot: Automation: mark INV-8821 as "primary_pending_verification" and INV-8821-1 as "awaiting_bank_verification"; task T-33277 created for payments verification. Audit note added.
payments_lead: Agreed to pay INV-8821 (bank A) in next run if vendor provides docs for INV-8821-1 before cutoff. If docs not received, pay INV-8821 and close INV-8821-1 as duplicate. We'll hold duplicate for 90 days.
tara_procure: Also add vendor alias to record to capture both remittance endpoints once verified. I'll open vendor-change request and tag vendor master for review.
me_fin: Thanks. One more: please notify procurement & legal if vendor sends conflicting signed docs from unknown email. We should confirm via AM or contract contact.
payments_lead: Noted. Payment rules applied. I'll update thread when bank-change form arrives or payment runs.
finance-bot: Next automated update scheduled in 48h or on document upload. Task T-33277 shows status: pending_vendor_docs.
me_fin: Closing for now; unresolved until bank docs come in. Thanks team.
